description: Long-running daemon. Every 3600s, queries mcp_signal_scores WHERE scored_at < now() - INTERVAL 7 days LIMIT 100. For each (server_id, signal_name) pair, dynamically imports the matching '<signal_name>_enrichment' module from /home/workspace/zo_sentinel/, fetches the latest registry metadata for server_id via ws_query, calls compute_score, ws_write the new score back to mcp_signal_enrichments (signal_bridge will flow it onward to mcp_signal_scores). Heartbeat. Lockfile. Skip server_ids no longer in registry. NO duckdb/sqlite3 imports. PER spec, enrichment compute_score is bounded 2s; modules exceeding it are logged and skipped via signal.alarm or threading-timeout pattern.
